# AGENTS.md - Session End Notes

Instructions to write comprehensive session notes to provide a concise and professional session summary to the user.

# Purpose

- At the end of each session, create a note in the directory .github/notes with all the codebase-related tasks.

- Take a note of all the things from the beginning to the end of the session.
    - Project-related tasks like:
        - Builds
        - Fixes
        - Tests
        - Improvements
        - Implementations
- Use note-taking practices and guidelines.
- Check existing notes in .github/notes to understand how notes are formatted.

*Make it 100% comprehensive so that absolutely nothing from the session is missed.
